crossRefs.note: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.
and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another…
Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have…
Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother…
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

translations.web: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
translations.bsb: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
translations.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
translations.asv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
